overview: The Void Nexus is the metaphysical heart of Akhevan void‑arcane cosmology, where all resonance flows converge.
history: Formed naturally during Luclin’s earliest void‑arcane fractures.
Akhevan architects built stabilizers to prevent total collapse.
Praesertum decrees restricted access after temporal distortions occurred.
Custodian orders established to maintain metaphysical equilibrium.
Modern Nexus remains the most dangerous and sacred site in Ka Vethan.
hooks: A temporal fracture expands beyond containment.
A resonance echo manifests with unknown origin.
Custodians request assistance with a corrupted void anchor.
A Praesertum ritual requires direct Nexus alignment.
